BackendLayers.Layer: The responsibility of the Repositories layer is to provide structured interactions with the database/context to higher level modules (Controllers, Services). The Repositories layer is the highest layer to interact with the database/context directly, and is used to encapsulate all of this lower-level logic and provide structured interfaces to higher-layer modules. Public methods within a Repository class should own their transaction where transactions are required.
